name: Rādhākṛṣṇa Ācārya (disciple of Kṛṣṇadāsa of Multān)
Gopāla dāsa (servant of Sanātana at Pāvana-sarovara)

fields.guru: Served Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī at Pāvana-sarovara

fields.place: Navadvīpa (house and sweet-shop near Mahāprabhu's house)
fields.notes: Sweet-maker of Navadvīpa, who loved Nimāi from His childhood; father of Mukunda. Came to see the Lord in Purī with his wife (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Antya 12.54-60). Not the same as Parameśvara dāsa Ṭhākura (#1080).
